headline: An additional 271 million soms allocated to support breeding livestock
summary: The Kyrgyz state has allocated an additional 271 million soms for supporting pedigree livestock breeding. The funds are lent at 3% annual interest until the end of the current year.
why: Subsidised credit for livestock breeders affects farm incomes and the supply of dairy and meat products in the country.
original_headline: На поддержку племенного животноводства дополнительно выделен 271 миллион сомов
